The *Telādi* section constitutes rules 2 through 8 of the Pāṭidesanīya (*Pātidesanīya*) chapter of the *Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga* in the Vinaya Piṭaka. These rules regulate the conduct of fully ordained nuns regarding the solicitation of specific luxury or delicate foodstuffs without being ill—namely oil (*tela*), honey, syrup, fish, meat, milk, and curd. A modern English translation has been produced by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

In terms of textual reuse and parallels, the text shares extensive stock phrasing with adjacent Vinaya rules.
